description:
## Goal
Enforce a 3-word-max naming convention on all internal (non-public) methods. Public API stays unchanged.

## Naming Convention
- Method names: max 3 underscore-separated words
- File names: already compliant (max 3 words)
- Public API: no changes (google_favicon_url, duckduckgo_favicon_url, extract_host_from_url, etc. stay as-is)

## Scope
Private methods with 4+ words across 7 files. All are internal implementation details with no public consumers.

## In Scope (4+ word private methods)
- `handle_gray_placeholder_with_uri` → `handle_gray_placeholder_uri` or `gray_placeholder_uri`
- `handle_fetch_result_with_uri` → `handle_fetch_result_uri` or `fetch_result_uri`
- `get_gray_placeholder_fallback_url` → `gray_fallback_url`
- `validate_and_parse_url` → `parse_validated_url` or `validate_url`
- `should_handle_gray_placeholder?` → `gray_placeholder?`
- `rate_limit_or_revalidate` → `check_rate_and_dns`
- `process_data_url_favicon` → `process_data_favicon`
- `fetch_data_url_favicon` → `fetch_data_favicon`
- `extract_favicons_from_site` → `extract_site_favicons`
- `extract_favicons_from_html` → `extract_html_favicons`
- `validate_non_negative_int` → `validate_non_negative`
- `webp_first_chunk_type` → `webp_chunk_type`
- `ip_in_private_range?` → `private_ip_range?`
- `exceeds_max_encoded_size?` → `exceeds_max_size?`

## Out of Scope
- Public API methods (google_favicon_url, duckduckgo_favicon_url, extract_host_from_url, etc.)
- File names (all already 3 words or fewer)
- 3-word methods (acceptable as-is)
title: Shorten private method names to 3 words max
